about.headline: Rooted on Lady's Island. Focused on clear, comfortable care.
about.introduction: Donovan Family Dentistry provides a welcoming local setting where patients can ask questions, understand their options, and prepare for the next step in their care.
storyParagraphs: Donovan Family Dentistry serves patients from its Lady's Island office with an emphasis on understandable information, thoughtful planning, and a comfortable experience.

Dr. William Donovan's background includes dental laboratory work, advanced general-dentistry education, and service as a U.S. Navy Dental Officer. Those experiences help shape a practical approach to planning and explaining care.
about.locationTitle: Close to home and easy to reach.
about.locationText: Located at 91 Sams Point Road, the office is convenient to Lady's Island, downtown Beaufort, Port Royal, and surrounding Lowcountry communities.
about.valuesTitle: Useful information, calm communication, and a clear next step.

values.title: Clear communication
values.text: Patients receive practical explanations, understandable options, and time to ask questions before deciding on care.

values.title: Comfortable visits
values.text: A friendly team, organized process, and calm environment help reduce uncertainty from check-in through follow-up.

values.title: Care across generations
values.text: Information and services are presented with the needs of children, working adults, retirees, and caregivers in mind.

journey.title: Before the visit
journey.text: Find office hours, directions, downloadable forms, and the right phone number without hunting through the site.

journey.title: During the conversation
journey.text: Expect plain-language explanations and a treatment plan organized around health, comfort, priorities, and timing.

journey.title: After the appointment
journey.text: Know what to expect next, when follow-up may be needed, and who to call with an administrative question.

teamPage.headline: The people and roles behind a comfortable visit.
teamPage.introduction: Meet the dentist and learn how the front-office, hygiene, and assisting teams support each visit. Individual staff names and photographs can be added whenever the office approves them.
teamPage.providersTitle: Experience, clear explanations, and a practical approach.
teamPage.providersIntroduction: Provider details are maintained in the office editor so the public page can stay current without changing site code.
teamPage.teamIntroduction: Role-based profiles keep the page useful now. The office can later publish individual names, biographies, and approved photographs or continue using team-level descriptions.

servicesPage.headline: Comprehensive care, easier to understand.
servicesPage.introduction: This page organizes the practice's published procedures into patient-friendly groups. Every service remains subject to office confirmation and an individual clinical evaluation.

groups.title: Restorative care
groups.summary: Repair damaged teeth and restore function with materials and treatment options selected for the individual situation.
groups.planning: A clinical examination helps determine whether a filling, crown, bridge, implant, or another approach is appropriate.

groups.title: Smile and tooth replacement
groups.summary: Explore options intended to improve appearance, replace missing teeth, and support confidence in your smile.
groups.planning: Bring questions about appearance, comfort, maintenance, timing, and how each option may fit your goals.

groups.title: Advanced and ongoing care
groups.summary: Address pain, infection, gum concerns, and teeth that may require more involved treatment.
groups.planning: Symptoms and urgency vary. Call the office so the team can explain the appropriate scheduling process.

servicesPage.planningTitle: Questions are part of the process.
servicesPage.planningText: The website can explain categories and help patients prepare, but a dentist must evaluate the individual situation before recommending treatment.
